title: Users table schema and migration
description: Define the users table schema using Drizzle ORM. The table must support email/password auth, Google OAuth, GitHub OAuth, AI provider settings (encrypted), and soft deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: users table is defined in src/db/schema/users.ts
Table exported from schema barrel index.ts
Running db:migrate creates the users table in PostgreSQL
Indexes exist on email and created_at
All nullable fields correctly typed as nullable in Drizzle schema

steps.details: Define the users table using Drizzle pgTable: id (uuid, primaryKey, defaultRandom()), email (varchar 255, notNull, unique), name (varchar 255, notNull), avatar_url (text, nullable), password_hash (text, nullable — null for OAuth-only users), github_id (varchar 255, nullable, unique), google_id (varchar 255, nullable, unique), github_access_token (text, nullable — encrypted), ai_provider (text, nullable — 'openai' | 'anthropic'), ai_api_key (text, nullable — encrypted), email_notifications_enabled (boolean, notNull, default true), created_at (timestamp, notNull, defaultNow()), updated_at (timestamp, notNull, defaultNow()), deleted_at (timestamp, nullable).

steps.description: Add indexes to the users table
steps.details: Export indexes: emailIdx = index('users_email_idx').on(users.email), createdAtIdx = index('users_created_at_idx').on(users.createdAt). Add these as named exports from users.ts.
At the bottom of users.ts, add: export type User = typeof users.$inferSelect; export type NewUser = typeof users.$inferInsert;
Run 'npm run db:migrate' in server/. Then connect to the database and run: \d users — verify all columns, types, nullability, and indexes are correct.

technicalNotes: Use uuid().defaultRandom() from drizzle-orm/pg-core for UUID primary keys
password_hash must be nullable to support OAuth-only users who have no password
github_access_token and ai_api_key are stored encrypted — do NOT store plaintext tokens
deleted_at is the soft-delete mechanism — queries must filter WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
